WITH cutoff AS (SELECT date('now','-2 years') as cutoff_date)
SELECT e.experiment_id, e.created_at, e.path, e.metadata,
       CASE WHEN e.path IS NULL OR trim(e.path) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_path
FROM experiments e, cutoff
WHERE date(e.created_at) < cutoff.cutoff_date
ORDER BY e.created_at;

args.query:
WITH cutoff AS (SELECT date('now','-2 years') as cutoff_date),
candidates AS (
  SELECT experiment_id, metadata
  FROM experiments, cutoff
  WHERE date(created_at) < cutoff.cutoff_date
),
included AS (
  SELECT '[' || group_concat('"' || experiment_id || '"') || ']' AS included_json
  FROM candidates
  WHERE lower(metadata) NOT LIKE '%export_block%'
),
excluded AS (
  SELECT '[' || group_concat('"' || experiment_id || '"') || ']' AS excluded_json
  FROM candidates
  WHERE lower(metadata) LIKE '%export_block%'
),
payload AS (
  SELECT '{"included_ids":' || COALESCE(included_json,'[]') || ',"excluded_ids":' || COALESCE(excluded_json,'[]') || ',"note":"Archived experiments older than 2 years. Excluded items flagged in metadata (export_block)."}' AS payload_json
  FROM included, excluded
)
INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT 'archive-' || strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%f','now')),
  'internal-archive',
  (SELECT payload_json FROM payload),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
SELECT last_insert_rowid() as inserted_rowid;
SELECT export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at FROM shared_export ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; SELECT entry_id, author, date, message FROM changelog ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1;
